title: CiteTrace sources
description: One row per unique URL. HF release columns: url_id, source_url, host_tier, crawl_yn, clen, SP_label, SD_label, ST_label, crawled_at_first. Pipeline JSONL additionally carries 'resolved_url' and 'failure_category'; these are stripped at HF release time.

source_url.description: Normalized URL (UTM stripped, Gemini proxy resolved)

resolved_url.description: Final URL after redirects (nullable when same as source_url or crawl failed)

host_tier.description: URL-domain regex classification (49 rules, LLM-free). Default: Commercial/Other. Appendix B.6.4.

clen.description: Length of crawled main content (chars). 0 when crawl_yn='N'

crawled_at_first.description: Captured immediately before page.goto() in crawler.crawl_url
